paths.working_dir.description: Base directory for Heat runtime data (e.g., locks, temp files).

logging.log_file.description: Path to the Heat log file. Set to empty string ('') to log only to stdout.

logging.level.description: Log level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

region.name.description: Name of the OpenStack region for multi-region deployments.

debug.description: Enable debug mode for verbose logging.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (more than INFO, less than DEBUG).

database.connection.description: Database connection string in SQLAlchemy format.

database.max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for database connection failures.

database.retry_interval.description: Seconds between database connection retry attempts.

notifications.driver.description: Notification transport driver. Use 'messagingv2' with RabbitMQ to send stack events toceilometer/aodh.

rabbit.ha_queues.description: Enable RabbitMQ mirrored queues for HA (requires broker-side queue mirroring).

rabbit.connection_retry_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up on RabbitMQ reconnect.

keystone.auth_url.description: Keystone identity service endpoint URL (v3 recommended).

keystone.project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for the Heat service account.

keystone.username.description: Username of the Heat service account in Keystone.

keystone.password.description: Password for the Heat service account in Keystone.

keystone.insecure.description: Disable TLS certificate verification (⚠️ insecure — disable only for testing).

keystone.service_token_roles_required.description: Require service token roles for internal API calls (enhances security).

keystone.interface.description: Keystone endpoint interface: public, internal, or admin.

cors.allowed_origin.description: List of allowed origins for CORS (e.g., ['https://myconsole.example.com']).

policy.file.description: Path to the JSON policy definition file.

conductor.host.description: Hostname/IP of the remote conductor. Leave empty to run local conductor.

api.bind_host.description: IP address to bind the Heat API server on.

api.bind_port.description: Port for the Heat native API server.

api.enable_cfn_api.description: Enable the AWS CloudFormation-compatible API on port 8000.

api.enable_heat_api.description: Enable the native Heat API on port 8004.

api.workers.description: Number of API server worker processes.

api.api_rate_limit.description: Enable API rate limiting (set to number of requests per minute; false = disabled).

engine.host.description: Unique hostname/IP for this engine worker (auto-generated if empty).

engine.stack_action_timeout.description: Maximum timeout for a stack operation (create/update/delete) in seconds.

engine.signal_receiver_use_cfn.description: Use CFN-style signal receiver endpoints (for WaitCondition compatibility).
